items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was born right in the city. Weren't the Carey's, I think? Or were they from the country? No, he was born in Hornville.

ctx.x: He was born right in the city. Weren't the Carey's, I think? Or were they from the country? No, he was born in Hornville. Oh, he was up there? Hornville, Louisiana. Oh, up there. We were up there for a parade.
Parade just about two weeks ago. Hornsville.
